title: Why decentralized identity will replace passwords forever

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: You know that password you use for everything? It's a security nightmare.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Right now, 80% of data breaches start with stolen passwords.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Decentralized identity lets you log in without ever typing a password.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses blockchain to create a secure, unique digital ID that you control.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects everyone — from banks to apps, making hacking nearly impossible.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Your identity belongs to you, not a company or hacker.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: So, are you ready to ditch passwords for good?

caption_text: Why decentralized identity will replace passwords forever
